name: lit-components
description: This folder is the **LitElement port** of `webcomponents/school-erp-wireframe/components/`. It preserves the existing tag names (`ui-button`, `ui-card`, `ui-input`, …) and design tokens, but drops the hand-rolled `BaseElement` in favor of [Lit](https://lit.dev), which gives us reactive properties, efficient template diffing, and better DX.
